rule.message:
The nursing major is available in two locations, the Twin Cities and Rochester. Students located in Rochester earn a University of Minnesota - Twin Cities (UMNTC) degree while taking courses on the University of Minnesota - Rochester (UMR) campus. Please note that foundational coursework and sequencing differs slightly for students at the Rochester location due to course availability at UMR. Policies, program requirements, course content, and timeline are the same at both the Twin Cities and Rochester locations. Contact the School of Nursing for more information.
At least 30 of upper-division (3xxx-level or higher) credits that satisfy major requirements must be taken through the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. For Rochester located students, credits for upper division foundational courses completed through the University of Minnesota Rochester will be included.
View sample plans for this major here . Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Transfer Admission Requirements:
Students applying to transfer into the Bachelor of Science in Nursing Program must meet the following requirements:
Completion of 6 prerequisite courses - Refer to Year 1 of the Program Requirements section for the list of coursework. University Writing is also a required prerequisite.
Minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA
Minimum 3.0 prerequisite GPA - All prerequisites must be taken using the A-F grading basis and must be completed for a letter grade of C- or higher. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Rochester, Twin Cities. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
